title: bedrock: doctor and `credential_failed` send the person to `fiber login bedrock`, which stores a key Bedrock never reads
note: Doctor ignored the credential() provider path and a test pinned the login remedy text; docs already said login is unsupported for Bedrock.

title: provider: a tool call whose arguments are not a JSON object is replayed as a string, and Bedrock refuses every later request in the session
note: Malformed args replayed as a string; Bedrock 400s every later request and resume. Docs said 'sent back as written', which cannot hold on object-input protocols.

title: cost: 1-hour cache writes are priced at the 5-minute rate, so `cost` and `budget.usd` under-count
note: Price summed all cache_write lifetimes at the 5-minute rate despite docs stating the 1h rate; found by reconciling field spend against vendor pricing.

title: A delegate closed after it exits cleanly reports 129: the drain exit code takes any late shutdown
note: A CI-reported failure of an existing test on a retry; the drain exit code took any late shutdown, so a clean delegate exited 129.

title: Gate misses run-time reads of repository files threaded through test helpers
note: The test-selection gate's run-time-read check missed reads through helper parameters; a gate gap, not shipped product behaviour.

title: tui: an accepted import opens one report overlay instead of a notice per line
note: Import filled the screen with 120+ notices; the doc itself prescribed one notice per line, so doc and tests pinned the bad behaviour.

title: tui: a hub on another Fiber version leaves unreadable rows mislabelled 'schema newer' and undismissable
note: A stale hub binary from another build produced unreadable rows wrongly labelled 'schema newer'; version-mismatch hub and terminal was never combined in tests.

title: hub: resuming a session whose workspace is gone says so and adds no rail card
note: Resuming a session whose workspace was deleted gave an IO error and an uncleared rail card; no doc said what should happen.

title: tui: home's session list scrolls under the mouse wheel
note: Home's session list did not scroll with the wheel; docs only said sections scroll when they outgrow the screen, naming no wheel behaviour.

title: Gate misses run-time reads of repository files outside docs and prompt
note: The gate's runtime-read check covered only docs and prompt paths; a gap in the test-selection tooling found by a lane.

title: flake: main::mcp_view login_against_a_fake_authorization_server_makes_the_server_ready (connecting vs needs-login)
note: Flake traced to an OAuth login state race in the mcp_servers reader; the fix seeded the reader with startup settled failures.

title: databricks: discovered models declare no thinking levels, so every model shows fixed thinking
note: Discovered Databricks models never got thinking levels; docs never said where a discovered model's levels come from.

title: login: fiber login databricks never asks for the workspace host, so its models stay unconfigured
note: Login stored the key but never asked for the workspace host; no doc step set it, so code matched docs and the journey had a gap.

title: tui: /quit just after turn start can exit instead of asking
note: Quit decided from lagging feed-row state, so /quit within milliseconds of turn start exited; surfaced as a flaky binary test.

title: tui: changing only the thinking level leaves the old level on the status line and Session card
note: Tester saw stale thinking level after a change; the fix was a notice that a mid-turn choice applies when the turn ends.

title: tui: a steering message is accepted but neither its queue row nor its card rule is drawn
note: Steer was accepted but its queue row and rule were not drawn; rendering code existed, but steers were not admitted into the shared steering queue.

title: tui: a finished delegate's view opens empty; Enter on its row subscribes to nothing
note: Finished delegate views returned no effect so nothing subscribed; code explicitly skipped jobs with an outcome.

title: tui: a ledger row at step 100000 or later draws wider than its width
note: Six-digit step numbers made the gutter exceed the width; an existing width invariant test never covered steps of 100000 or more.

title: Main red: paging peak RSS over the 11,988 KiB ceiling #2750 set
note: A PR lowered memory budget rows to bare measurements against the doc's rule; main's backstop failed. A budget-doc fix, not product behaviour.

title: Shutdown may leave an extension callback and its host.exec running until the callback's timeout
note: Shutdown did not stop an in-flight extension callback or its host.exec; only the case clock had been run, never the real clock.

title: A queued picker read runs without the picker's refreshing mark
note: A queued picker read started without its refreshing mark after another read answered; found via a flaky SIGHUP test failing in a lane gate.

title: Lua extension tools: accept and pass declared hosts and hosts_surfaced
note: Docs let Lua tools declare hosts but effects_from refused the key and Effects was built with hosts None; found when building web_render.

title: config: no notice for an ignored repository-role credential
note: The credential was dropped silently though the doc promised a notice; a test pinned the silent drop by asserting no notice.

title: delegate run: the runner starts a second watch after fiber_exited when the watch finishes mid-iteration
note: A stale exited_seen read let the runner start a second watch after fiber_exited; a scripted watch rarely hit the window, seen as a rare flake.

title: doors: a shell stopped before it starts is answered invalid_arguments
note: A shell stopped by cancel or close before starting was answered invalid_arguments; the owner ruled a new cancelled code, since no doc covered it.
